verdict.rationale: Shopify's agentic commerce evidence describes agent-driven, on-demand flows (catalog search, cart, checkout, order tracking) that are invoked per-transaction via MCP tools/CLI, but there is no evidence of scheduling, triggers, or persistent background automations that run autonomously without an active session or invocation. Order webhooks are Shopify-initiated notifications, not user-configured background automations. missing for 10: any documented scheduling/trigger mechanism, background job or automation-runner, or persistent autonomous task execution independent of an active agent session.
